import csv, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from relayboard.testing import request
from relayboard.web import create_seeded_app
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
e = root / ".experiment"
app = create_seeded_app()
code, body = request(app, "GET", "/dashboard")
assert code == 200
assert body.count("<th>Latest result</th>") == 1
assert "<th>Last result</th>" not in body
assert body == (e / "dashboard_after.html").read_text()
assert body == (e / "dashboard_before.html").read_text().replace("<th>Last result</th>", "<th>Latest result</th>")
jobs_code, jobs = request(app, "GET", "/api/jobs")
alerts_code, alerts = request(app, "GET", "/api/alerts")
api = {"jobs_status": jobs_code, "jobs": jobs, "alerts_status": alerts_code, "alerts": alerts}
assert api == json.loads((e / "api_before.json").read_text())
assert api == json.loads((e / "api_after.json").read_text())
assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--", "relayboard/web.py"], text=True) == (e / "lead-diff.txt").read_text()
with (e / "decisions.tsv").open() as stream:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(stream, delimiter="\t"))
assert len(rows) == 7
for row in rows:
    for pointer in row["evidence"].split(", "):
        path = (root / pointer).resolve()
        assert path.is_relative_to(root) and path.is_file(), pointer
records = [json.loads(line) for line in (e / "commands.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
for record in records:
    assert record["cwd"] == str(root)
    path = (root / record["output"]).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(root) and path.is_file()
assert records[0]["exit_code"] == 1
assert all(record["exit_code"] == 0 for record in records[1:])
for action in json.loads((e / "action-path-log.json").read_text()):
    for pointer in action.get("paths", []):
        path = (root / pointer).resolve()
        assert path.is_relative_to(root) and path.is_file(), pointer
print("PASS: live WSGI heading, exact before/after markup, captured GET jobs/alerts equality, actual diff equality, seven TSV evidence rows, command output pointers, action-log path pointers.")
print("Audit limit: captured command/checkpoint evidence only; no exported raw transcript.")
